name: ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT is an advanced conversational AI developed by OpenAI. It can engage in natural language conversations, answer questions, help with writing, coding, analysis, and much more. Built on the GPT-4 architecture, it represents the cutting edge of language model technology.

name: Midjourney
description: Midjourney is an AI-powered image generation tool that creates stunning artwork from text descriptions. It's widely used by artists, designers, and creators to generate unique visual content with exceptional quality and artistic style.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI pair programmer that helps you write code faster and with less work. It draws context from comments and code to suggest individual lines and whole functions instantly, powered by OpenAI Codex.

name: Notion AI
description: Notion AI is integrated directly into Notion's workspace, helping you write better, think bigger, and work faster. It can summarize content, generate ideas, fix spelling and grammar, translate text, and much more.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Stable Diffusion is an open-source text-to-image model that generates detailed images from text descriptions. It's highly customizable and can be run locally, making it popular among developers and researchers.

name: Jasper AI
description: Jasper is an AI content platform that helps teams create high-quality content faster. It's designed for marketers, bloggers, and businesses to generate blog posts, social media content, ad copy, and more.

name: Copy.ai
description: Copy.ai is an AI-powered copywriting tool that helps you create marketing copy, blog posts, social media content, and more in seconds. It's designed to help marketers and content creators overcome writer's block.

name: Runway ML
description: Runway is a next-generation content creation suite powered by AI. It offers tools for video editing, image generation, and creative AI applications, making advanced AI accessible to creators.

name: Grammarly
description: Grammarly uses AI to help you write clearly and effectively. It checks your grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style, offering suggestions to improve your writing across all platforms.

name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia is an AI video generation platform that creates professional videos from text. It features AI avatars that can speak in multiple languages, making video production accessible without cameras or studios.

name: Dall-E 3
description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's latest image generation model that creates highly detailed and accurate images from text descriptions. It understands nuance and detail better than previous versions.

name: Perplexity AI
description: Perplexity AI is an AI-powered search engine that provides direct answers to questions with cited sources. It combines the power of large language models with real-time web search.

name: Claude
description: Claude is an AI assistant created by Anthropic. It's designed to be helpful, harmless, and honest, with strong capabilities in analysis, coding, creative writing, and complex reasoning.

name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs provides AI voice generation and text-to-speech technology with incredibly realistic and expressive voices. It's used for audiobooks, content creation, and voice cloning.

name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor built to make you extraordinarily productive. It features AI-powered code generation, editing, and debugging capabilities integrated directly into the editor.

name: Canva AI
description: Canva's AI-powered design tools help you create stunning graphics, presentations, and social media content. Features include Magic Design, background remover, and AI image generation.

name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai provides AI-powered transcription services that convert speech to text in real-time. It's perfect for meetings, interviews, lectures, and any audio content that needs to be transcribed.

name: Replicate
description: Replicate makes it easy to run machine learning models in the cloud. It provides access to thousands of open-source AI models through a simple API, without managing infrastructure.

name: Hugging Face
description: Hugging Face is the leading platform for machine learning collaboration. It hosts thousands of models, datasets, and provides tools for building, training, and deploying ML models.

name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and analyzes your meetings. It integrates with popular video conferencing platforms and provides searchable transcripts and insights.

name: Descript
description: Descript is an all-in-one video and podcast editing tool that uses AI to make editing as easy as editing a document. It features transcription-based editing, AI voices, and studio-quality effects.

name: Tome
description: Tome is an AI-powered storytelling tool that helps you create compelling presentations and narratives. It uses AI to generate content, layouts, and visuals based on your prompts.

name: Gamma
description: Gamma is a new medium for presenting ideas powered by AI. Create beautiful, engaging content with none of the formatting and design work. Just start writing and Gamma does the rest.

name: Framer AI
description: Framer's AI features help you design and build websites faster. Generate entire pages from text prompts, create copy, and optimize layouts with AI assistance.

name: Beautiful.ai
description: Beautiful.ai uses AI to automatically design your presentations as you create them. It ensures your slides always look professional with smart templates and design rules.

name: PhotoGenerAI
description: PhotoGenerAI creates and edits photos with AI — text-to-image, image-to-image, enhancement and style presets. Free to try in the browser without sign-up, with paid credit packs and subscriptions for more generations.
